scope: Independent text-only mathematical review of all eight source files, examples, authored French narration and stated assumptions; targeted book passages checked. Exact Fraction calculations, finite counting enumerations and numerical checks corroborate the analytical review. No claims of visual, audio or continuous playback acceptance.

checks.name: 66 main candidate product
checks.result: Both algebraic candidates give product 8; only 3 has both original logarithm arguments positive.

checks.name: 66 original domain
checks.result: Intersection x>1 and x>-1 is x>1; the condensed logarithm additionally admits x<-1.

checks.name: 66 self-check quadratic
checks.result: Expansion (x-1)(x+2)=12 gives x^2+x-14=0 and discriminant 57.

checks.name: 66 self-check original equation
checks.result: Only (-1+sqrt(57))/2 satisfies the original logarithms; substitution passed.

checks.name: 67 affine composition c=5
checks.result: Exact fraction substitutions agree with both symbolic cancellation identities for nonzero affine slope 3.

checks.name: 67 affine composition c=7
checks.result: Exact fraction substitutions agree with both symbolic cancellation identities for nonzero affine slope 3.

checks.name: 67 comparison values
checks.result: Inverse(4)=3, reciprocal of f(4)=1/7; inverse(5/3)=20/9.

checks.name: 67 reciprocal exclusions
checks.result: Reciprocal denominators exclude 5/3 and 7/3 respectively; affine inverses accept every real input.

checks.name: 68 orientation reversal
checks.result: Reversing v changes signed component from -3 to 3, leaves projected vector (-3,0) and length 3 unchanged.

checks.name: 68 geometric equal units
checks.result: Both displayed geometric axes scale by 0.78 screen units per numerical unit.

checks.name: 69 marked occurrence overcount
checks.result: 300 marked occurrences versus 271 distinct codes; the multiplicities are 1, 2 and 3.

checks.name: 69 exhaustive binary self-check
checks.result: All 256 binary strings enumerated; 255 contain at least one 1 and 8 exactly one 1.

checks.name: 70 net expectation
checks.result: Both outcome weighting and subtracting the constant entry fee give -2 dollars.

checks.name: 70 ten-play expectation
checks.result: Exact binomial expectation of ten independent plays is -20; several totals remain possible.

checks.name: 70 fair die self-check
checks.result: Net outcomes 5 and -1 give expectation zero; zero is not a single-play outcome.

checks.name: 71 edge values
checks.result: Analytic proof: on D, x+y>=2; the entire segment (s,2-s), 0<=s<=2, attains 2, so -x-y attains maximum -2 there.

checks.name: 71 unbounded sequence
checks.result: The admissible family (t,2) for all t>=0 makes x+y=t+2 arbitrarily large; finite checks only corroborate this explicit analytic formula.

checks.name: 71 self-check coefficient identity
checks.result: C=(3/2)(2x+y)+(1/2)y>=9. Equality forces both 2x+y=6 and y=0, hence the unique minimizer (3,0).

checks.name: 72 period and amplitude
checks.result: Period 12.4h, midline 2.8m, amplitude 2m from explicitly consecutive extrema.

checks.name: 72 exact phases
checks.result: The phase is 0, pi and 2pi at the declared times, giving 4.8, 0.8 and 4.8 exactly.

checks.name: 72 missed-extremum ambiguity
checks.result: Period 12.4/3 also fits the two isolated extrema; next/consecutive is needed for unique period.

checks.name: 72 self-check
checks.result: 9+6*cos(pi*(t-2)/4) has maxima at 2,10,18 and minimum at 6.

checks.name: 73 cooling values
checks.result: The excess halves every 10 minutes: total readings are 50 then 35, not halves of total temperature.

checks.name: 73 accessible range and inverse
checks.result: For finite t>=0, 20<T<=80. Inverse t=10*log2(60/(C-20)) is nonnegative exactly for 20<C<=80; equilibrium is approached but not attained.

checks.name: 73 self-check
checks.result: With ambient 10 and half-life 4 minutes, T(4)=40 and T(8)=25.
